revisionDesc.change: Finalized - done
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - second reading is clear; first would need more justification to be accepted

Vote - AcceptText - Accept the second reading only: ἐ̣[π]εὶ ἤκ̣ο̣υσα in lin12 yields good sense, but ει (no dots?) is a bit hopeful, η (no dot?) not nice, and κ̣ο̣ is too tight; I wouldn't put it forward. But θαυμά|ζω δὲ πῶς in lins14–15 looks good.
Submit - Corrections in ll. 12, 14-15

Commit - The papyrus is in a bad state. Further improvements are possible though through a local (microscopic) inspection in Vienna. Two corrections: l. 12 ε̣ὑ̣ρ̣ίσ̣κ̣ο̣υσα => ἐ̣[π]εὶ ἤκ̣ο̣υσα (more justifiable); ll. 14-15: θ̣αῦμα | ὅ̣τ̣ι̣ οὐδέπως => θαυμά|ζω δὲ πῶς (supported by numerous examples). The end of l. 13 and the beginning of l. 14 are also probably wrong but I have no well-founded proposal (e.g. l. 14 ἑτέραν αἰτοῦ?)
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine
